interface.longDescription: Set up and run an insurance brokerage on Koter, the CRM and back-office platform for brokers in Brazil, by talking to ChatGPT: guided setup, auto insurance multi-quote, contracts and commissions, payouts, cash flow, CRM leads and tasks, capture forms, WhatsApp (KoterZap) knowledge bases and chatbots, and data import from another system. The connection signs in with OAuth on your own Koter account and only reaches what your role allows and the areas you approve. The skills ask before any write that reaches your customers, such as a WhatsApp message, an e-mail or turning on a chatbot. The skills are written in Brazilian Portuguese, for brokers in Brazil. Requires a Koter account.

pt-BR.subtitle: Toque sua corretora no Koter
pt-BR.description: Configure e toque a sua corretora no Koter conversando com o ChatGPT: configuração guiada, multicálculo auto, contrato e comissão, repasse, caixa, lead e tarefa do CRM, formulários de captura, base de conhecimento e chatbot do KoterZap e importação de outro sistema. A conexão entra com o seu login do Koter e só alcança o que o seu cargo permite e as áreas que você marcou. As skills pedem a sua confirmação antes de qualquer gravação que chegue ao seu cliente, como mensagem de WhatsApp, e-mail ou chatbot ligado. Precisa de uma conta no Koter.

publication.release_notes: First version of the Koter plugin for ChatGPT: 30 skills in Brazilian Portuguese plus the Koter connector (OAuth). Covers guided setup, CRM, proposals, commissions and payouts, WhatsApp chatbots and knowledge bases, auto insurance multi-quote and data import.

positive.description: Shows which Koter areas the connection reaches.
positive.prompt: Which Koter areas can you access?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the brokerage's toolsets (CRM, management, KoterZap, auto quote and others) and shows that they are all enabled. Nothing is written.

positive.description: Reads the most recent CRM leads.
positive.prompt: List the 5 most recent leads in my brokerage.
positive.expected_behavior: A table with 5 leads (name, stage, source, created at) and the total number of leads. Nothing is written.

positive.description: Creates a CRM task and deletes it, asking before each write.
positive.prompt: Create a task called 'Review test' for tomorrow at 10am, with no actions and no guests, then delete it.
positive.expected_behavior: Asks for confirmation before creating the task and again before deleting it. After both steps, the task no longer exists.

positive.description: Reads the commission summary of the month.
positive.prompt: Show me this month's commission summary by insurer.
positive.expected_behavior: A summary grouped by insurer with expected, received and pending commission for the current month. Nothing is written.

positive.description: Tests the WhatsApp chatbot in the simulator, without messaging anyone.
positive.prompt: Simulate a customer saying 'hi, I want a health plan quote' on my WhatsApp chatbot.
positive.expected_behavior: Picks the brokerage's chatbot, runs the message in the simulator and shows the simulated reply and path. No message is sent to anyone.

negative.description: General consumer advice, not a task in the broker's Koter account. The plugin should not be invoked; ChatGPT answers generally or asks for context.
negative.prompt: What health insurance plan should I buy for my family of four in São Paulo?

negative.description: Drafting text only. No Koter tool is needed and nothing should be sent; ChatGPT writes the message for the user to copy.
negative.prompt: Write a short WhatsApp message I can send to a customer reminding them that their car insurance renews next month.

negative.description: General knowledge about Brazilian insurance regulation. The plugin should not be invoked.
negative.prompt: Explain how SUSEP licenses insurance brokers in Brazil.
